messages:
Anya Rao: Uploaded a compact mock focusing on streaming readability, stop/try-again copy, token badge placement, and prompt-suggestion behavior during streaming. Figma: https://figma.redwood/playground-compact (mock-6)
Miguel Santos: Quick decision: token badge realtime or snapshot? I vote realtime but low-contrast and fixed to avoid layout shifts.
Shilpa Patel: Accessibility: stop/try-again must be tabbable with clear aria-labels. Streaming region shouldn't auto-reposition SR focus. Test role=status vs region.
Dave Kim: Microcopy change: secondary action -> "Try again". Tooltip: "Stop generation (partial output preserved)".
Olivia Chen: Add offscreen SR hint: "Stops current generation; partial text remains selectable." Recommend Esc as shortcut.
Anya Rao: Prompt library clicks mid-stream: show a small confirm: "Replace and run? This will stop current generation." Buttons: Replace & Run / Queue / Cancel.
Miguel Santos: Also show an undo toast when replaced: "Prompt replaced  Undo" for 4s.
qa-bot: Uploaded test build with token badge overlay and confirm sheet to staging: https://staging.redwood/playground/compact-v6
Anya Rao: Action items: Shilpa -> a11y tests, Miguel -> badge prototype & undo toast, Olivia -> keyboard tests, Dave -> copy updates. Reconvene in 24h.
